(() => { const c=document.querySelector('.arch-canvases, .building-stage').getBoundingClientRect(); const p=document.querySelector('.live-assistant-panel').getBoundingClientRect(); if(Math.abs(c.left)>2 || Math.abs(c.right-p.left)>2) throw Error('Canvas must fill only the space beside chat'); return {canvas:c.toJSON(),chat:p.toJSON()}; })()
